role_instructions:
# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
format_template:
For each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:
<tool_call>
{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}
</tool_call>

component_definition.R: All system text before <tools>, excluding the system-role wrapper.
component_definition.T: The complete <tools> schema block, including its trailing separators.
component_definition.F: The complete function-call output-format instruction and literal <tool_call> example.
component_definition.system_role_wrapper: Retained in all 2^3 cells so the model receives a valid native chat prompt; L7 of the separate request ladder removes it.
